genius.notes: EURCV has official MiCA authorization as an EMT, but that does not establish a U.S. GENIUS permitted-issuer approval or registered foreign-issuer exception. No token-specific U.S. PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, OCC registration, Treasury comparability determination, or foreign-issuer exception was located. SG-FORGE's public U.S. selling restriction supports a conservative posture. Applicability is marked apparent-payment-stablecoin because the statute covers payment or settlement tokens redeemable for a fixed monetary value; the euro denomination and offshore restriction remain verifier review points.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No SG-FORGE/EURCV U.S. issuer authorization, OCC application or foreign registration, or Treasury comparability determination was located in this named source/search scope. The OCC table covers digital-asset bank licensing and is not asserted to be an exhaustive GENIUS foreign-issuer register. This review does not establish universal absence or the status of every federal/state rulemaking; MiCA licensing is not U.S. permission, and the EURCV whitepaper prohibits issuer transactions with U.S. residents.
